answers.goal: I would love to be a voice over casting director  with my own agency or being an executive in-house casting director for a company like Pixar or Dreamworks.
answers.drew: I’ve always been very intertwined with the Industry growing up and both myself and my family have always been huge animation fans with some family members working it in. I’ve always wanted to work in entertainment, more specifically in the animation field, but behind the microphone rather than in front of it. I truly believe that the most magical and influential medium in entertainment is animation and would love to keep working in it for the rest of my life!
answers.seeking: I would absolutely love to connect with people in the casting or talent representation sphere. For my job I’m constantly emailing back and forth with agents and producers but it would be amazing to actually sit down and get to know some of these people face to face.
answers.inspiration: I would say my top three biggest inspirations are Andrea Romano (casting director for almost every critically acclaimed animated DC project and helped cement DC characters to their animated voice over signatures), Brad Bird (legendary pixar director and known for getting insane VO performances from actors with minimal VO experience), and Haywo Miyazaki (THE Studio Ghibli director who took crazy leaps and gambles for unknown VO actors in his movies).
answers.favorite: Movie: Paprika. TV Show: Over the Garden Wall
